svg.title: Projects and achievements
svg.desc: WorthScout (in production): SaaS for resellers: photograph an item, get a resale assessment against live market data, then list it. React, TypeScript, Fastify, PostgreSQL, Stripe. worthscout.co.uk. Regen Radar (2nd place, treefera hackathon): Tests a farming change against Sentinel-2 satellite data and control fields. Signal, not proof. London Climate Action Week 2026, Python, Jupyter, React, Recharts. Gurnski/Treefera-Hackathon. BSGO Private Server: Battlestar Galactica Online closed in 2019. Rebuilt on BSGOCore, playable with the original client. 12,250 cards, 58 star systems, Java, JavaScript, Python. Gurnski/BSGO-Private-Server. ADRM Engine: Backtester for rule-based forex strategies, with an early MetaTrader 5 integration. Python, research, not a product. Gurnski/ADRM-Engine.
